name: TX2-60L MedX Ready
description: 6-axis robot arm developed under an ISO 13485:2016-compliant quality management system for OEM integration into medical and surgical systems. Features a hygienic encapsulated design resistant to clinical disinfectants, submillimeter repeatability, and IP65/IP67 protection. Optional MedXguiding interface provides intuitive manual hand-guiding with configurable force transparency modes for clinical positioning. Not classified as a medical device itself; intended for integration into medical equipment by OEM manufacturers. Applications include orthopedics, neurosurgery, interventional oncology, diagnostics, robot-assisted imaging, and rehabilitation.
